other_conditions: Must be a native of Uttar Pradesh and currently studying in Uttar Pradesh
Must be studying in government schools, aided or recognized educational institutes of the state
Eligibility is based on cut‑off merit of marks percentage of the previous year, subject to budget availability
benefits_summary: Provides fee reimbursement for eligible OBC students, with up to ₹50,000 annually for certain courses and lower amounts for other course groups.
